# Trajectory

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Trajectory`](gmeow-Trajectory.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Trajectory>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
